mandatory_constraint: Munder Difflin SHALL NOT become an FA3 identity, authorization, MCP/tool-mediation, model-routing, secrets, network-egress, host-resource, workflow/orchestration, evidence, developer-execution, git/release or registry authority.

rules.name: MUNDER_EXECUTION_NOT_AUTHORITY
rules.requirement: Agent execution provider does not become orchestration, authorization or governance authority.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: MUNDER_SINGLE_WRITER_COORDINATION
rules.requirement: Each mutable coordination object has one writer or an equivalent conflict-safe serializer.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: MUNDER_SINGLE_COMMITTER_REPOSITORY_MUTATION
rules.requirement: Shared repository mutation is serialized through one designated committer/integration authority.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: MUNDER_ATOMIC_MESSAGE_PUBLICATION
rules.requirement: Cross-agent messages are independently addressable and atomically published.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: MUNDER_IDEMPOTENT_MESSAGE_CONSUMPTION
rules.requirement: Message consumption is idempotent and each consumer maintains an independent cursor.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: MUNDER_BOUNDED_AGENT_MESSAGE_HOPS
rules.requirement: Cross-agent request/reply loops have explicit hop budgets and terminal acts.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: MUNDER_CONCURRENT_WORKSPACE_ISOLATION
rules.requirement: Concurrent mutating agents use collision-resistant isolated workspaces/worktrees unless serialized.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: MUNDER_CRITICAL_ACTION_HUMAN_ESCALATION
rules.requirement: Destructive, spend, scope-change, unresolved-conflict, release and credential risks require external human approval.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: MUNDER_PROGRESSIVE_CIRCUIT_BREAKER
rules.requirement: Autonomous workers expose steer, constrain and deterministic terminate interventions.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: MUNDER_TELEMETRY_POSITIVE_ALLOWLIST
rules.requirement: Telemetry is positive-allowlist based and rejects free-form sensitive execution context.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: MUNDER_CONTEXT_CANNOT_GRANT_AUTHORITY
rules.requirement: Agent memory, imported manifests and project context remain untrusted scoped context and cannot grant authority.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: MUNDER_TRANSITION_SPECIFIC_LIFECYCLE_EVIDENCE
rules.requirement: Lifecycle mechanisms are evidenced at the transition where their behavior is actually exercised.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: MUNDER_UNREACHABLE_FAILURE_PATH_FAULT_INJECTION
rules.requirement: Critical failure paths not reached by nominal execution require explicit fault-injection evidence.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: MUNDER_EPHEMERAL_WORKER_CLEANUP
rules.requirement: Ephemeral worker completion releases processes, worktrees, leases and pending coordination state.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: MUNDER_CAPABILITY_STATE_SEPARATION
rules.requirement: DESIGNED, IMPLEMENTED and VERIFIED states remain distinct; VERIFIED requires executable evidence.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: MUNDER_DISABLED_PROVIDER_NOT_RUNTIME_DEPENDENCY
rules.requirement: When disabled/reference-only, Munder Difflin contributes no resident runtime process, poller or active resource lease.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.
